hypothesis: Is the frozen P82 readout information linearly recoverable, and does a predefined cosine annealing schedule rather than constant LR resolve terminal convergence, with exact original P82 memory and unchanged 544 trainable seam parameters? Strong 256-float conventional baseline must not be hidden.

source.generator: Per-world independent orthogonal 16D keys, 8 action targets twice each with independent tanh 16D actually observed effects, 8 random nuisance actions and observed effects. Uniform interleaved 24 factual events. Delayed executed final query receives key16 + 16 zero unknown future effects. No role/time/query/future effect in historical writes.
source.audit: FIT/VAL 4-quartile role departure<=.05 and held-out index-only balanced accuracy<=.55, zero final unknown effect features, distinct seed families, SHA256 source hashes. OOD and negative never generated before all VAL competence checks. Authored synthetic, not external scientific environment.

arms.model: Pinned original HybridPilot(32,16,width16,heads2,SSM+attn+TTT+depth). Original original raw factual 16x16 float32 bounded TTT eta=.5, no extra memory. Frozen backbone/depth; train only original ttt.proj(272)+head(272), exactly 544 parameters.
arms.constant: P82 corrected hidden=head(ttt.proj(raw_read)+.05*depth(context)), AdamW constant .01 all 300 steps, weight_decay .01, batch16.
arms.cosine: Same hidden and initial weights as constant, SAME 300 updates, same batch indices, AdamW cosine LR .01*(.01+.99*(1+cos(pi*step/300))/2), step 0..299, min .0001; nothing tuned from outcomes.
arms.original_fusion: P82 uncorrected native-context+raw memory fusion=head(depth(context+ttt.proj(raw_read))), 300 constant AdamW paired steps, 544 params.
arms.ridge: FIT-only 16D corrected initial hidden->consequence float64 ridge alpha=.01 with bias unregularized (272 fitted head params); unequal parameter-count/whole-process compute diagnostic, not matched optimizer arm.
arms.fixed: Original direct P78 256-float W@action and P72 256-float key/effect frequency cache; zero predictor. Original SSM/attention costs beyond 256 floats must be reported.

training.selection: Best validation MSE checkpoint only, no transfer tuning. All trained arms same original initial weights and FIT batch sequence; report 10-validation trajectory, selected step, model SHA, training time, param counts.
training.cold: Exact bitwise 256-float factual state and query read, no hypothetical updates.

gates.pre_transfer: All source/blobs/negative admission/cold controls and conventional fixed baselines each <=.75 zero VAL. For each original core seed ridge FIT-only <=.9 strongest fixed direct VAL. For cosine all three best VAL <=.95 strongest fixed direct, <=.8 paired constant and original-fusion VAL, selected step <300 and last three checkpoint errors <=1.05 own best. Any miss => stop before novel transfer & negative source creation, preserve FAIL and per-arm trajectory.
gates.transfer: If and only if all 3 pre-transfer pass, once generate 128 new 48-event author synthetic OOD worlds, require each cosine <=.9 strongest direct fixed baseline, and paired 2000-bootstrap worlds lower relative gain 95% >0; no OOD tuning.
gates.negative: Only if transfer qualifies, generate 64 independent wrong-credit worlds, shuffle factual effect associations, compare correct vs corrupted MSE ratio>=1.4 for all cosine seeds.
gates.interpretation: Ridge sufficient but cosine frozen gate fails -> learnable linear feature, unresolved optimizer/criterion; ridge also fails -> frozen feature insufficiency; do not infer original fully trained model learning. Full cross-platform regression and independent science separate.
gates.strict: Do not retune after failed preregistration, do not generate P83 transfer/negative on VAL failure, do not claim whole-process FLOP or fully trained model parity.
